LoginIntro: Sign in with your passkey — Face ID, Touch ID or your device PIN. No password needed.
LoginFailed: Sign-in didn't work. Please try again.
LoginNoPasskeys: No passkeys are registered yet — create an account first.
RegisterIntro: Pick a name and create a passkey — that's all, no password.
SetupSecretHint: Only needed for the very first setup — find the code in the server logs.
SetupSecretInvalid: Setup code is missing or wrong. You'll find it in the server logs.
RegisterFailed: Registration didn't work. Please try again.
InstallHint: Tip for iPhone/iPad: install the app via “Add to Home Screen” first — that keeps you signed in permanently.
PasskeysEmpty: No passkeys registered for this account.
PasskeysNotLoggedIn: You're not signed in on this device yet.
PasskeysAdd: Add a passkey on this device
PasskeysConfirmWarning: Remove “{0}”? A device that uses this passkey can no longer sign in with it.
PasskeysLastBlocked: The last passkey of an account can't be removed.
PasskeysActionFailed: That didn't work. Please try again.
PasskeysPendingExplanation: Not active yet — approve it below once you recognize the device, or reject it if you don't.
PasskeysAddedPendingInfo: New passkey added — approve it below before it can be used to sign in.
LoginPendingApproval: This passkey is waiting for approval on an already signed-in device. Open the passkey list there, approve it, then try again.
LinkNewDeviceInstructions: On the new device, open /link in a browser (same address as this app) and enter this code:
LinkIntro: Enter the code shown on your other, already signed-in device to connect this one.
LinkSuccess: This device is linked and waiting for approval on your other device. Open the passkey list there and approve it, then come back here to sign in.
LinkInvalidCode: That code is invalid or has expired. Generate a new one on your other device.
LinkConnectFailed: That didn't work. Please try again.
GoToLinkDeviceLink: Link a device with a code
RecoveryLoginThrottled: Too many attempts — please try again later.
RecoveryCodesConfirmWarning: Existing codes will become invalid. The new codes are shown only ONCE — store them safely.
RecoveryCodesOnceHint: Each code works exactly once. Save them now — there is no second view.
RegisterInviteRequiredHint: An invite link is required to register. Please use the link you were given.
RegisterInviteInvalid: This invite link is invalid, expired, or has already been used.
PasskeysRevokeOthers: Sign out on all other devices
PasskeysRevokeOthersDone: All other devices have been signed out.
